purpose: Compact rank-fusion and training-history switching study, declared before scoring; no supervised meta-model.
selection_metric: all_primary MAP@5; template_primary is reporting only
fusion: sum of weight/(offset+one-based component rank), absent ID contributes zero
tie_break: full10_t50 training-popularity rank, then numeric programme ID
fallback: full10_t50 training popularity; identical for every user with no 50%-qualified training history

controls.truth: Original strict >=80% validation truth; no pruning or relabelling
controls.cohorts: Original 4030 users and nested 1150 template users
controls.component_selection: Previously studied full history: MF/PPR 50%; CBF/rules 80%
controls.switch_feature: Distinct programmes in training_counts.parquet for full10_t50, zero for absent users
controls.segment_definitions: Original strict/full reference bins and familiarity, unchanged
controls.search_scope: All thirteen configurations below are retained; no subsequent weight search in this stage
controls.uncertainty: Conditional paired-user bootstrap only; same temporal hold-out has already been used for selection
